_comment: Community profile — runners rated significantly clear of their field using Form King Weight-Adjusted Rating (Weight Adjusted Rating) margin fields. Requires fields/war_margin.py (included by default). Copy the profile object you want into profiles.json to activate it.

profiles.name: Last-start rating 3+ points clear of field
profiles._comment: Runner's most-recent Form King Weight Adjusted Rating is at least 3 points above the best-rated rival. Quick signal — only considers the last start.

profiles.name: Best-2-of-last-3 rating 5+ points clear of field
profiles._comment: More stable than last-start alone — averages the runner's two best Form King Weight Adjusted Ratings from its last three valid starts, then compares to the best rival. A 5-point margin is a meaningful edge.
